glosses: conflict; strife; war (clash, often violent, between multiple parties)
conflict (a state where things operate towards different results due to incompatibility)

examples.text: Há um grande conflito entre religião e ciência.
examples.en: There is a great conflict between religion and science.

examples.text: Ele não parece estar por dentro do conflito entre mim e o meu pai.
examples.en: He doesn't seem to be aware of the conflict between my father and me.

examples.text: As Nações Unidas enviaram tropas para intervirem no conflito.
examples.en: The United Nations sent troops to intervene in the conflict.
